paragraphs: R' Yishmael ben Sitriel (in the time of Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi]) – Bekhorot 57b.[^1]

notes.text: Yishmael’s title is abbreviated and retained as R'. The separate רבי is explicit and remains Rabbi; bracketed Yehudah HaNasi is the inherited contextual reader clarification, not an independently bound identity. 57b follows the colon convention, without named-edition verification.
